scopes.boundScope: Furthest checked carrier bound: at a=0,b=1, use the proved critical homogeneous exponent 2k(u+1)-k(k+1)/2+eps for every eps>0, with k>=2,u>=k. The complete initial allowance is at most B*p^beta, -1/2<=beta<0, with every homogeneous and descendant-energy premise discharged. Prime, padded-quotient and p^S<=X conditions are explicit. Constants and thresholds are unevaluated. Full signed correlations, sampling and block normalization remain; their combined saving is unproved. RH remains open.
scopes.sourceScope: Under the displayed hypothetical right-half-zero assumptions, the normalized original carrier has the prescribed negative-multiplicity source limit. This conditional source identity supplies one side of the proposed contradiction; its independent arithmetic counterpart remains open.
scopes.initialConditioningScope: The actual unweighted J_((u+1)k,k)(X) has the critical exponent 2k(u+1)-k(k+1)/2+eps for every k>=2,u>=k,eps>0 and every sufficiently large endpoint. Uniform improvement above each fixed defect closes the infimum argument, without an assumed moment budget. Both actual Korobov product moments receive this bound, retaining the whole joint resonance envelope. Eps=0 and all smaller orders are not asserted. Evaluated parameter costs, resonance, zeta growth and the combined weighted saving remain open.
scopes.exponentAuditScope: Exact normalization audit: after restoring the source scale, lowering the exponent changes only the deep remainder by the coarse-quotient power. Every original intermediate conditioned energy is identical. The complete scaled allowance is no larger when a full coarse window fits. This comparison bounds no intermediate energy and does not prove RH.
scopes.fullRecurrenceScope: The general original-carrier recurrence applies to every displayed finite scale pair a<=b and depth H. Both actual quotient moments use the proved first improved exponent; all intermediate energies remain in the full allowance. The default view uses the critical exponent plus positive epsilon and a proved negative initial profile under its deeper cutoff conditions. No net signed correlation saving or RH contradiction is asserted.
